 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The 2026 Heritage Classic will be this Sunday between the Winnipeg Jets and the Montreal Canadiens. The outdoor NHL game is typically between two Canadian teams (occasionally the Buffalo Sabres are welcomed into the mix), though it's not an annual event; this is the first time the game has been on the regular schedule in three years. This year's game will be held at the Princess Auto Stadium in Winnipeg, and keep an eye out for the teams' special game-day jerseys .
 The Heritage Classic between the Jets and Canadiens will air in the U.S. on Sunday, Oct. 25 at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT on TNT, truTV and HBO Max . Here's everything you need to know about watching this weekend's game.
